opening.argument: The speaker presents an advertising service for technical-repair businesses through a tutorial-style demonstration. The video shows a Google Ads policy-help page and a Search Keywords dashboard with computer-repair keywords and campaign performance columns. The speaker offers help running ads and asks viewers to make contact. Those are observable features of a commercial offer, not evidence that anyone was deceived or lost money. The claimed method, compliance with Google's rules, and campaign success remain unverified promotional assertions. The available evidence does not establish theft or any transaction outcome.
